verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs say you can always export your notes to an open format such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder repeats this on HN as the answer to lock-in concerns, so the core of the story is delivered. The evidence is thin, though: one line of docs plus a vendor statement. The API cannot serve note contents because notes are end-to-end encrypted, so export is not available programmatically. Missing for 10: detailed export docs confirming the whole knowledge base is covered (attachments, images, backlinks, tags preserved), any programmatic or automated export path, and independent hands-on confirmation of export quality.
